rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name and zip, checked the pending order, and identified the air purifier item. They obtained confirmation and a reason for the attempted cancellation. When removal failed due to tool constraints, they offered an exchange and correctly found and swapped to the cheapest available variant, with the tool confirming a refund of the price difference. However, the agent executed the exchange without first stating the exact change (specific variant, price, and refund destination) and obtaining explicit confirmation, which violates the policy requirement for pre-write confirmation. Additionally, the user later requested the refund be issued to their gift card (which exists on the account), and while it may not be changeable post-transaction, the agent could have confirmed refund destination before performing the modification (the tool accepts a payment_method_id). Because the order-changing write occurred without explicit confirmation, this fails the pass bar.
